title: Countdown Into Neon Night
tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the supplied frames
Not visible in the supplied frames

judge.summary: The ad has a bold neon look and a clearly readable, sustained event card, though the complete countdown and musical synchronization cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

must_haves.item: The video is 8 seconds long in 9:16.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 8 seconds and the frames have the requested vertical proportions.

must_haves.item: Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
must_haves.why: A large 2 is visible at 1 second, followed by the event card at 3 seconds; the unsampled intervals could contain 3 and 1, but neither is shown.

must_haves.item: Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
must_haves.why: The audio description does not establish the music genre, build, or synchronization.

must_haves.item: Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
must_haves.why: Only one countdown frame is supplied, so flashing or changing countdown graphics cannot be established.

must_haves.item: The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.
must_haves.why: All three lines are fully readable and unclipped on the same card at 3, 5, and 7 seconds.
The supplied audio report explicitly states there is no clear speech.
